name: tft128_gc9a01_8pin
title: Round 1.28-inch TFT on a GC9A01, eight contacts
description: A round 240x240 colour display on SPI, on a board with cut corners and eight contacts: the backlight on a line of its own, BLK
notes: U1 on the back is a socket for a ribbon with the same eight lines; Q2 switches the backlight.

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: GND VCC SCL SDA RES DC CS BLK from the top on both sides.

silkscreen.source: the back: 1.28"TFT V1.0, IC:GC9A01, 240*240, Active Area Diameter:32.4mm. Not tried.

levels.source: No regulator is seen, so VCC is taken as the 3.3 V of the panel. The start is what the GC9A01 driver starts with, not tried.
